title: Calloway Limited Home Warranty Billing Note: Amount of the Missed-Appointment Charge
content:
**Clause.** A missed-appointment charge on a Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage is worked out for the most recent missed appointment recorded on the coverage — the one with the latest appointment date — on the day it is assessed, and it is linked to that appointment's claim item. The count of missed appointments is every missed appointment recorded on the homeowner's coverage, the one being charged included. The billable number of the missed appointment is that count less the program's free missed appointments, and a missed appointment whose billable number is zero or less carries no charge. For a missed appointment whose billable number is one or more, the charge is the program's missed-appointment fee, rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

**Accepted callback awaiting repair.** A missed appointment that fell while its claim item had an accepted callback awaiting repair carries no charge, because an accepted callback carries no fee; such a miss is still counted among the coverage's missed appointments. The claim item had an accepted callback awaiting repair on the missed appointment date when the item's latest callback is dated on or before the missed appointment date, and the item's latest repair is either dated on or before that callback, dated on or after the missed appointment date, or not recorded at all.

## Input, judgement, output

| Input read from the coverage's records | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Item of the latest missed appointment had an accepted callback awaiting repair that day | Callback awaiting repair | No charge (the miss still counts) |
| Billable number zero or less | Within the free missed appointments | No charge |
| Billable number one or more | Chargeable | The program's missed-appointment fee, rounded to the cent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical program figures: missed-appointment fee USD 75.00, free missed appointments 1)

1. Three missed appointments are recorded on the coverage, the latest on an item with no callback. Count 3; billable number 3 less 1, that is 2; charge USD 75.00.
2. One missed appointment is recorded. Count 1; billable number 0; no charge.
3. The latest missed appointment, on 12 May, concerns an item whose latest callback is dated 2 May and whose latest repair is dated 20 April. The repair precedes the callback, so a callback was awaiting repair on 12 May: no charge, and the miss counts toward later appointments.
4. As in case 3, but the item's latest repair is dated 8 May. The repair falls after the callback and before the missed appointment, so no callback was awaiting repair; the charge follows the billable number.
